name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage explorer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta province, Argentina. The project hosts Proven and Probable Mineral Reserves of approximately 124 Moz silver and 1.1 Moz gold. The company graduated from the TSX Venture Exchange to the Toronto Stock Exchange in February 2025.
